ADR-001.title: Tenant Isolation via Explicit Context Session
ADR-001.content: All database and service queries must obtain tenant_id exclusively from the cryptographically verified JWT session context (core.context.get_current_tenant_id()). Endpoints are forbidden from accepting tenant_id as a client‑controlled URL parameter or request body field. Database queries must enforce row‑level security or explicit User.tenant_id == get_current_tenant_id() filter.

ADR-002.title: Idempotent Webhook Processing & Async Retries
ADR-002.content: All external webhook consumers must store incoming idempotency event IDs in Redis with a 72‑hour TTL; background task handlers must be decorated with @idempotent_task; failed jobs must use exponential backoff with dead‑letter queue escalation.

ADR-003.title: Mandatory Parameterized SQLAlchemy Core Queries
ADR-003.content: Prohibit all Python f-string or string formatting inside SQL queries. All queries must use SQLAlchemy select() / update() construct with explicit parameter binding.

CONV-01.title: Store webhook event IDs in Redis with 72‑hour TTL
CONV-01.content: Webhook consumers persist the idempotency event ID in Redis, expiring after 72 hours to prevent duplicate processing.

CONV-02.title: Decorate background task handlers with @idempotent_task
CONV-02.content: All async task handlers must be wrapped with the @idempotent_task decorator to enforce idempotency.

CI-FAIL-89.title: CI Run #89: Tenant search test suite broke due to unparameterized SQL query
CI-FAIL-89.content: Test test_tenant_search_isolation failed with SQLSyntaxError when query contained special characters. Caused by f-string interpolation in users/search endpoint.

PR-142.title: PR #142: Fix SQL injection in search & enforce ADR-003 parameterized query binding
PR-142.content: Refactored user search filter to use SQLAlchemy select(User).where(User.username.ilike(...)) and context tenant_id. Added automated regression test.

VULN-CWE-89.title: CWE-89: SQL Injection in User Search Endpoint
VULN-CWE-89.content: Reported vulnerability where query parameters were directly formatted into raw SQL string. Resolved by PR #142 adhering to ADR-003.

TEAM-PREF-01.title: Comprehensive Pytest Fixtures with Rollback
TEAM-PREF-01.content: Every database test must use the async_session fixture with transaction rollback to keep test sandboxes isolated.

RUNBOOK-01.title: Security Vulnerability Remediation Runbook
RUNBOOK-01.content: 1. Isolate reproduction test in tests/ directory. 2. Verify ADR compliance. 3. Apply patch using Regolo coding specialist. 4. Run automated test suite with zero-trust verification.

# ADR-003: Mandatory Parameterized SQLAlchemy Core Queries

## Status
APPROVED (2026-07-20)

## Context
A critical vulnerability (CWE-89) was discovered in the user search filter where raw Python f-strings formatted user input into SQLite/Postgres query strings, causing CI Run #89 to fail.

## Decision
1. Never use raw string formatting (`f"SELECT ... {param}"` or `.format()`) inside any database

# Repository Coding Standards

## 1. Async-First FastAPI Architecture
- All API route handlers must be defined as `async def`.
- Database I/O must use `AsyncSession` with `await session.execute(...)`.

## 2. Input Validation & Strict Typing
- Every endpoint payload must be typed using Pydantic V2 `BaseModel`.
- Type annotations (`mypy` strict) are required for all function arguments and returns.
